input.explanation: No. The slow work happened inside this repository. `typical_spend_per_item` in src/io_shop/typical_spend.py ran repeated min/remove over the whole purchase list, so its cost grew with the square of the history length. `render_spend_summary` in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py calls it whenever typical-purchase-feature is on. The patch replaces that loop with one sort in the same function and gives the same results. Nothing outside this repo needs to change: once the patch is deployed, turning the flag back on uses the cheaper path.
